correctness.rationale: In the telegraph model dot X=-1/(1+X)+v sigma, sign flips rate gamma and starts x>1/v-1, the generator backward equations yield an integrating factor (v^2(1+x)^2-1)^(-beta/2), beta=2gamma/v^2, for d_n=(m_n^+-m_n^-)/2. Monotone comparison gives nonnegative d_n; diffusive-scale martingale lower bound forces the weighted source integral to diverge if beta<=2n-1. Positive polynomial Foster–Lyapunov functions s^(2j)+(jv/gamma) sigma s^(2j-1) and compact regeneration prove finiteness if beta>2n-1. Vanishing boundary flux then yields the exact recursion C_n=1/(2^n product_{j<=n}(1-(2j-1)/beta)) for m_n~C_n x^(2n) and leading positive orientation gap 2n C_{n-1}/[v(beta-2n+1)] x^(2n-1). Independent symbolic generator/coefficient checks passed; finite-grid upwind diagnostics in package are nonproof.
